name: cdk8s
description_en: Define Kubernetes native apps and abstractions using object-oriented programming
readme_excerpt: Cloud Development Kit for Kubernetes cdk8s is an open-source software development framework for defining Kubernetes applications and reusable abstractions using familiar programming languages and rich object-oriented APIs. cdk8s apps synthesize into standard Kubernetes manifests which can be applied to any Kubernetes cluster. cdk8s is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation Sandbox Project, built with ❤️ at AWS.
